The long awaited Lasagna Soup! 🍝 I’m finally getting around to making this viral soup and WOWWW it’s insanely good! It honestly might be my favorite soup of the series!  Let me know if you make it! Here’s how:  1/2 yellow onion, diced (about a cup) 6-8 cloves minced garlic, to taste 1/2 lb hot or mild Italian sausage (I used hot) 1/2 lb lean ground beef 2 T tomato paste Salt and pepper to taste 1-2 t Tony’s Seasoning, to taste 1 t dried basil 1 t dried parsley 1 t dried oregano 1 t Italian seasoning 1/2 t red pepper (to taste) 24 oz marinara 1/2 cup heavy cream 4-6 cups chicken stock, depending on how soupy you want it 1/2 lb Laguna noodles, broken into pieces Handful of fresh basil 1 cup parm 1 cup ricotta 1 cup mozzarella 1/4 cup fresh parsley Salt and pepper to taste 1. In a medium bowl, combine your parm, ricotta, mozzarella, parsley, salt and pepper. Set aside. 2. In a large soup pot or dutch oven, heat your olive oil over medium heat. Add in your onion, add a pinch of salt, and cook for 4 minutes.  Throw in your garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  3. Add in your sausage and beef, breaking into pieces with a wooden spoon. Cook for a few minutes and then season with your salt, pepper, basil, oregano, parsley, Italian, red pepper, and Tony’s. Cook until no longer pink. 4. Add in your tomato paste and stir. Cook for a couple minutes. Pour in your chicken broth and marinara. Bring to a boil.  5. Pour in your lasagna pieces, reduce heat, and  simmer for about 10 minutes, or until al dente, stirring occasionally.  6. Once your noodles are done, add in your heavy cream and fresh basil (torn). Adjust seasonings if needed. Stir, serve, and top with a dollop of your ricotta mixture. videos.caption: BBQ Cheeseburger sliders are an easy weeknight dinner the whole family will love!  INGREDIENTS 12 count King’s Hawaiian Rolls 1 lb ground beef 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika   1 tbsp minced garlic  2 tbsp BBQ sauce  Pepper jack cheese slices Shredded colby jack cheese   Crispy fried onions  6 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled  2 tbsp melted butter  Sesame seeds  INSTRUCTIONS Preheat your oven to 350 degrees F.  Cook 1 lb of ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika. Once the ground beef is browned, drain any extra grease from the skillet. Add the minced garlic and BBQ sauce. Stir well.  Slice Hawaiian Rolls in half and put the bottom of the rolls in a greased baking dish or on a sheet pan.  Add a layer of pepper jack cheese. Add the ground beef on top of the cheese. Top the ground beef with shredded colby jack cheese, some crumbled bacon, and crispy fried onions. Top with a little bit more BBQ sauce if desired!  Put the tops of the slider rolls on and brush them with melted butter. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top. Bake at 350 degrees F for about 10-15 minutes. Enjoy! #easyrecipes #appetizers #dinner #cheeseburger

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

The one recipe of mine you NEED to make, ONE PAN MARRY ME CHICKEN ORZO. Life changing! 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut up into cubes 2 tb olive oil 4-5 cloves garlic, mashed 3/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, in oil, drained 2 tsp italian seasoning 2 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp ground black pepper 1 cup orzo 2 3/4 cups chicken broth (or water) 3/4 cup full fat coconut milk or heavy cream 2 large handfuls fresh spinach 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Pat chicken dry and cut into cubes. Add olive oil to a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add the chicken. Stir and cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges start to cook. Add in the sun dried tomatoes, garlic, italian seasoning, paprika, salt & black pepper. Cook for 3-4 minutes more, then add the orzo and broth and stir well. Reduce heat to medium. Cover the skillet and cook for 12 minutes, removing the cover every few minutes to stir and ensure nothing sticks to the bottom of the pan. Once the orzo is cooked through, add the coconut milk/cream and spinach and stir another minute until the spinach is wilted, then add in the parmesan cheese and stir once more. Remove from heat, plate and enjoy!   #20minutedinner #easyrecipes #marrymechicken #valentinesdaydinner #easydinner

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

Buffalo Chicken Hot Pockets 🍗 (Makes 10 Hot Pockets)  Macros Per Hot Pocket:  - 425 Calories - 50g Protein  - 44g Carbs  - 4g Fat  Ingredients (Dough)🥯:  - Self Rising Flour (500g) - Greek Yogurt (0% Fat) (520g) - 1 Tbsp Garlic Salt (15g) - 1 Tbsp Italian Seasoning (8g) Ingredients (Buffalo Chicken Filling)🍗:  - 40oz Chicken Breast (1135g) - 0.5 Tbsp Garlic Salt (7g) - 0.5 Tbsp Smoked Paprika (3g) - 2 Tbsps Ranch Seasoning (8g) - 0.5 Tbsp Black Pepper (3g) - 4 Tbsps Tomato Salsa (60g) - 1 Cup Diced White Onions (100g) - 0.5 Cup Buffalo Sauce (120g) - 3.5 Cups Fat Free Mozzarella (392g) - Fresh Chives (10g) Ingredients (High Protein Buffalo Sauce):  - 1.5 Cups Cottage Cheese (335g) - 2oz 1/3 Fat Cream Cheese (56g) - 0.5 Tbsp Garlic Salt (7g) - 0.5 Tbsp Black Pepper (3g) - 0.5 Tbsp Onion Powder (3g) - 0.5 Cup Buffalo Sauce (120g) - 0.25 Cup Fat Free Milk (60g)    Freezing Instructions ❄️: 1. High Protein Honey Butter Chicken Alfredo Pasta🍗🍯🧀 One of the most indulgent meal preps i’ve made! The rich, sweet & savoury flavour of the chicken pairs beautifully with the light, fragrant creaminess of the pasta🤤 Macros Per Serving (5 Total) 635 Calories | 60g Protein | 55g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 5) Honey Butter Chicken - 1000g Raw Chicken Breast, small cubes - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 1.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Parsley - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Olive Oil - 40g Reduced Fat Butter (for cooking + glaze) - 20g Honey (for all the chicken) - 15g Soy Sauce (for all the chicken) - 2 Tbsp Fresh Parsley, chopped • Cook chicken on medium heat for 3-4 mins each side in a single layer till golden brown and crispy • Lower the heat, then add extra butter, honey and soy sauce. Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato — just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 ⸻ 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g garlic butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping ⸻ Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. ⸻ 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. ⸻ 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan ⸻ 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #bakedpotato #lasagna

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Creamy lemon garlic pasta with Parmesan crusted chicken 🍋🤍 full recipe below!     Ingredients  - 3 chicken breast, thinly sliced  - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 cup panko bread crumbs  - 3 eggs - 1 cup all purpose flour  - 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese  - 2 tsp garlic powder - 2 tsp onion powder - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp salt  - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 12 oz fettuccine noodles  Cream sauce - 2 cups heavy whipping cream - 1/4 cup lemon juice - 1/4 cup pasta water - 1 lemon, zested - 3 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp olive oil - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 1 shallot, finely chopped  - 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp lemon pepper  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp oregano  - Salt to taste (taste and add as needed) Instructions  - Season chicken breasts on both sides. Set aside. - In one shallow bowl, place the flour. In another, whisk the eggs. In a third bowl, combine the breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. - Dredge each chicken breast in the flour, followed by dipping it into the egg, and then coating it with the breadcrumb-Parmesan mixture. Press the breadcrumbs gently to ensure a good coating. - Heat the olive oil or neutral cooking oil in a large skillet over medium heat. I highly recommend arriving earlier for sunrise - or even doing it for sunset.  ⏰If you don’t plan on stopping, the drive will take about 2 hours from the west entrance to the east entrance, but I highly recommend getting out along the way to explore. pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

8 easy freezer chicken marinades 🌿 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/4 cup honey 1/4 cup soy sauce 3–4 cloves garlic, minced 1–2 tbsp olive oil 1–2 green onions, sliced Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then cook in crockpot (low 4–6 hours) or on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with rice and veggies. ⸻ Lemon Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/4 cup olive oil Juice of 1–2 lemons 2–3 cloves garlic 1 tsp Italian seasoning Salt & pepper 1–2 lemon slices Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then bake at 375°F or cook on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with rice, potatoes, or veggies. ⸻ Greek Style Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt 2 tbsp olive oil Juice of 1 lemon 2 cloves garlic 1–2 tsp oregano Salt & pepper 1/4 red onion, thinly sliced 1-2 tbsp dill  Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then grill, bake, or cook on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with rice, pita, or a salad. ⸻ Basil Balsamic Chicken Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar 2 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp honey 2 cloves garlic Fresh basil (or 1 tsp dried) Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. Thaw overnight, then bake at 375°F or cook on stovetop until fully cooked. Serve with pasta, rice, or roasted veggies. Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts or thighs 1 cup teriyaki sauce ½ cup pineapple juice 1 tbsp soy sauce 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tsp ginger Pineapple chunks Green onion + sesame seeds Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Cook on low 5–6 hours in the crockpot or bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes. Serve over rice with broccoli. ⸻ Pesto Mozzarella Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts 1 cup pesto ¼ cup olive oil 2 cloves garlic, minced Cherry tomatoes Mozzarella pearls Salt + pepper Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes or grill until fully cooked. Serve with pasta, rice, or roasted vegetables. ⸻ Honey Mustard Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts or tenders ½ cup honey ⅓ cup Dijon mustard 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt + pepper Parsley or thyme Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes or air fry at 375°F for 15–18 minutes. Serve with potatoes or green beans. ⸻ Buffalo Ranch Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 lbs chicken breasts or tenders ¾ cup buffalo sauce ¼ cup ranch 1 tbsp cream cheese (optional) 1 tsp garlic powder Salt + pepper Green onion Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Cook on low 5–6 hours in the crockpot for shredded chicken or bake at 400°F for 25–30 minutes. Serve over rice, in wraps, or with roasted potatoes. #freezermeals #chickenmarinade #freezermealprep #easymealprep #mealprepideas

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Butter Chicken Recipe 🍛🔥👇🏼  For chicken:   2 chicken breast   3 tbsp Greek yogurt   Minced ginger   1 tsp garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, cumin   1/2 lemon   For sauce:   1 tbsp butter   1/2 onion   2 fresh cloves garlic   1/2 tsp paprika, cumin, salt and chicken bouillon powder (optional)   2 1/4 cup tomato passata   1-2 tsp sugar   1 cup heavy cream   2 tbsp butter   cilantro   First, we’re going to cut the chicken into small cubes and season it with the spices, fresh ginger, lemon, and Greek yogurt. Blueberry pull apart bread 🫐✨ Ingredients  Bread - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1/2 tsp salt Blueberry compote - 300g blueberries (about 2 cups) - 95g granulated sugar (10 tbsp + 2 tsp) - 1 tbsp lemon juice  - 12g cornstarch (cornstarch slurry) - 2 tbsp water (cornstarch slurry) Icing (didn’t measure) - Confectioners sugar - Melted butter - Whole milk - Splash of vanilla extract  - Splash of lemon extract  Instructions  Filling - In a medium sauce pan on medium heat combine blueberries, sugar, and lemon juice. Stir until well combined and cook until bubbling. - Add cornstarch slurry and stir constantly until very thick.  - Transfer into a heat safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and cool for 10 minutes on the counter then refrigerate for 30-40 minutes. Bread - In a bowl, combine warm milk and 1 tbsp sugar. Sprinkle yeast over the top, stir lightly, and let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add eggs, 1/3 sugar, and mix again until well combined. - Add flour to mixture. Mix until a rough dough forms. - Begin kneading. Once the dough starts to come together, gradually add the softened butter (1 tbsp at a time), kneading until fully incorporated before adding more. - Continue kneading 8–10 minutes by hand or 5–6 minutes in a stand mixer, until smooth, elastic, and slightly tacky. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - Punch down dough and roll into a rectangle about 12x18 inches - Spread filling evenly across the surface - Cut into strips, then stack and cut again to fit upright into a greased loaf pan (1/2 pound loaf pan) - Cover loosely and let rise 30–40 minutes, until puffy. - Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 35–40 minutes, tenting with foil if the top browns too quickly. - Top with icing and serve!  • • • #recipes #baking #springrecipes #bakingrecipe #recipeideas

Three ingredient 🍋 Lemon Posset  UPDATE: This recipe requires these 3 exact ingredients to work. They interact and cause a chemical reaction to get the end result. If you use a different style sweetener it may not set. If you need a dairy alternative I'd encourage you to look up a vegan version of this dish as it would require other ingredients to work.  Here’s what you need👇 4 large Lemons for juice and cups (6 tbsp of juice) 2 cups Heavy Cream (this cannot be substituted for anything else- it's essential for the recipe) 1/2 cup Granulated Sugar 1 tbsp Lemon Zest *I topped mine with decorative sugar and a raspberry* Prepare the Lemon Cups: Cut the lemons in half widthwise. Using a spoon or small knife, carefully scoop out the flesh and juice, being careful not to puncture the rind. Save the inside flesh of the lemon, squeeze out the juices and strain into a bowl or cup and set it aside for the filling. Set the halved lemon cups onto a tray or plate so they are sitting upright and are stable. Make the Lemon Posset: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the heavy cream, sugar, and lemon zest (if using). Stir occasionally and bring to a gentle simmer. Let it bubble lightly for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove the pan from heat and slowly whisk in the lemon juice. The mixture will begin to thicken naturally as you do this. Fill and Chill: Carefully pour the warm posset into the prepared lemon cups (or into small jars if not using the cups). It helps to add the lemon posset filling into a liquid measuring cup with a pour spout for easier transfer. Let them cool at room temperature for about 30 minutes, then refrigerate for at least 2.5-3 hours or until fully set. Before serving, you can garnish with sanding sugar and a berry if desired. #lemonposset #lemon #easydessert #brunch #easterrecipes #mothersdayideas

honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

Biscoff cinnamon rolls! the long awaited recipe is here 😍✨ this is seriously the best cinnamon flavor i’ve done! the cookie butter really makes this recipe memorable 🤎 recipe below ⬇️ Dough:  * 540 g bread flour * 2 1/2 tsp active yeast * pinch of salt  * 3/4 cup milk * 2 room temp eggs  * 1 tsp vanilla extract or paste      * 1/2 cup granulated sugar * 1/2 cup room temp butter * 1/2 cup greek yogurt * 1/2 cup cream for soaking the rolls after proofing! do not put into dough directly  Biscoff Filling * 1/4 cup room temp butter * 1/4 cup biscoff cookie butter ( melt for easy mixing) * 1/2 cup crushed biscoff cookies * 1/2 cup brown sugar * 1 tbs ground cinnamon Cream Cheese frosting * 8oz/ 1 block of cream cheese * 1 3/4 cup powdered sugar * 1/4 cup melted biscoff cookie butter  Optional Topping  * crushed biscoff cookies  1. Activate yeast using yeast packet into a warm milk bowl with 1 tbs of granulated sugar ( from the 1/2 cup for the dough) Let sit for 5-7 minutes. Should be foamy at the top. Do not use hot water! it will kill the yeast 2. mix flour and salt together in a separate bowl. throw in yeast mixture, eggs, sugar, vanilla, soft butter and greek yogurt together. mix together until combined for 1 minute and rest for 5. mix until  a dough ball forms. shouldn’t stick to the bowl at all or surface. add flour as needed. cover with plastic wrap or towel to let proof for at least an hour. 3. meanwhile dough proofs combine all ingredients for the biscoff filling. 4. also meanwhile dough proofs like your baking tray with parchment paper and lightly grease with butter or oil spray. 5. after proofing time is over, roll dough into 15x16 square and spread filling. Cut into strips and roll, i made this into 12 medium rolls.  6. Place into lined baking dish. Cover rolls and let proof again for 45 minutes. 7. After proofing warm up the cream and  cover each roll.  8. for my rolls i baked then at 350F for around 30-35 minutes. keep an eye on them until they’re golden brown or each internal temp of 190F-200F. 9. Meanwhile baking combine all ingredients for cookie butter cream cheese frosting. set aside. 10. admire the deliciousness 🤭 then spread cream cheese frosting across rolls! 11. Top with biscoff cookie crumble and whole cookies. Let cool for 15 minutes then enjoy.  #baking #cinnamonroll #biscoff #viral #christmas #holidays #holidayrecipe #christmasrecipe #cinnamonbun #biscoffrecipe #cinnamonrolls #cozyrecipe #dessert #fallrecipe #recipeidea #bakingidea #fyp #foryou #christmasgiftideas

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Drain on paper towels, brush lightly with melted butter, and coat in sugar while still warm. 8. School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Looks can be deceiving, much like how this meal looks like it took you hours to prepare! 😉 This Parmesan Ranch Chicken is as easy as one, two, three! Continue reading or click the link in the @allrecipes bio to get the full recipe! 🔗 Ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken cutlets 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/2 cup plain yogurt 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons ranch seasoning mix 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 2 green onions, thinly sliced Directions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). If using whole chicken breasts, cut them in half lengthwise to form 6 chicken cutlets. Arrange chicken in a single layer in the bottom of a lightly greased  baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together mayonnaise, yogurt, Parmesan, ranch seasoning, salt, and pepper until well combined.  Spread mayonnaise mixture over in a thick layer evenly over the chicken and bake about 17 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Without removing the chicken from the oven, turn the oven temperature to Broil and cook until browned and bubbly on top, another 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes; sprinkle with green onions before serving. 🧑‍🍳: Nicole #parmesanchicken #chickendinner #chicken #dinner #dinneridea

SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. Cinnamon rolls… made in 20 minutes, and every bite is the center of the cinnamon Roll In depth recipe with pictures on substack!!! 🛒 Ingredients Dough 1 cup (130g) all purpose flour 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1 tsp cinnamon 1/3 cup (80ml) milk (or half milk, half heavy cream) 1 tsp vanilla 1 tbsp melted butter Coating 1 tbsp melted butter 3 tbsp sugar 1-2 tsp cinnamon Vanilla Bean Glaze ✨ 4 tbsp powdered sugar 2 tsp heavy cream 1/2 tsp vanilla Vanilla bean or vanilla bean paste 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Preheat oven to 375°F and grease or line your pan 2️⃣ In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon 3️⃣ Warm milk slightly, then mix in vanilla and melted butter 4️⃣ Pour wet into dry and mix until a soft dough forms, stop as soon as it comes together, don’t overmix 5️⃣ Lightly flour your surface, roll dough into a log, flatten slightly, and cut into 20 even bites 6️⃣ Toss each piece in melted butter, then coat fully in cinnamon sugar 7️⃣ Place in pan in a single layer with a little space between each, no stacking 8️⃣ Bake 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden, don’t overbake 9️⃣ While baking, mix glaze until smooth, adjust thickness if needed 🔟 Let bites cool 1 to 2 minutes, drizzle glaze over the top while warm, and enjoy ⏱ Time & Servings Prep 10 min Cook 10 min Serves 2 to 3 🔥 Pro Tip Mix just until the dough comes together, overmixing is what makes these dense instead of soft and pillowy. Soup on Sunday: Marry Me Chicken Soup 💍🍗 Marry Me Chicken is one of my FAVORITE dishes and when I found a soup recipe inspired by it, I asked zero questions. I did find that I wanted to add more broth than the original recipe called for and I also don’t think the cream cheese is 100% necessary. It looked perfectly creamy without it, BUT I wanted to give the original recipe a shot. But do what sounds best to you!! Recipe by: Savor & Nest • ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes (julienne-cut, packed in oil with herbs) • 1 tbsp oil from sun-dried tomato jar • 1 ½ cups chopped yellow onion • 4-6 cloves garlic, minced • 3 tbsp tomato paste • 6-8 cups chicken broth, depending on how thick you want it • 1 cup heavy whipping cream • 4 tsp fresh basil (plus more for garnish) • 2 tsp kosher salt • 1 ½ tsp dried Italian seasoning • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp crushed red pepper (or more if you like heat) • 8 oz uncooked medium shell pasta • 3 cups fresh baby spinach, roughly chopped • 2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken • 8 oz cream cheese, cubed (room temperature) • 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese, finely shredded (plus more for garnish) INSTRUCTIONS:  • Heat 1 tablespoon of sun-dried tomato oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened, then add and cook garlic until fragrant. • Stir in tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the tomato paste deepens in color. • Pour in the chicken broth, cream, basil, salt, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and crushed red pepper. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Let it simmer for 12 minutes. • Add the pasta, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. • Lower the heat to low, then stir in spinach, shredded chicken, cream cheese, and Parmesan. Stir often for 5 minutes until the cheeses melt and the chicken is warmed through. • Ladle into bowls, garnish with extra Parmesan. #soup #marrymechickensoup #easyrecipe #food #souprecipe

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

High Protein Cheesy Honey Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas🔥🍯🍗 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 10 Total) 484 Calories 33C | 14gF | 65gP Ingredients: 1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1.5 Packets Chipotle Seasoning (homemade or Cholula Chipotle Seasoning) 1 Tsp Olive Oil 400g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 2 Tsp Chipotle Seasoning (Cholula) 80ml Light Mayonnaise (Heinz) 2 Garlic Cloves 1/2 Juiced Lime 2 Tsp Chipotle In Adobo Sauce (La Costena) 80ml Buffalo Sauce (Franks Redhot Buffalo Sauce) 100g Honey 40g Light Grated Cheese Diced Chives 10 Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese - per quesadilla) Directions: 1. Start by seasoning your chicken breast with chipotle seasoning, olive oil & mix. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken with a lid for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side or until fully cooked through, once cooked shred the chicken apart using 2 forks. 3. In a blender cup add low fat cottage cheese, chipotle seasoning, light mayonnaise, garlic, lime juice, chipotle in adobo sauce, buffalo sauce, honey & blend for 2 minutes until smooth & creamy. 4. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Place a warm tortilla down & to one half add a layer of cheese followed by 1/10th of the filling, another layer of cheese & fold. 6. Toast on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas.  #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

#recipeideas #gelatin  Gelatin is collagen just in a different form. Collagen is a structural protein found in animal tissues like skin, bones, and connective tissue. When you take that collagen and cook it (heat + water), it breaks down into gelatin. What actually happens: 	•	Collagen has a tight, triple-helix structure (very strong and rigid) 	•	When heated, that structure unwinds and partially breaks down 	•	This creates a softer, more digestible form → gelatin So when you see: “Unflavored natural gelatin (bovine)” 	•	“Bovine” = comes from cows 	•	“Unflavored” = no additives 	•	“Gelatin” = collagen that has been hydrolyzed by heat

One pot chicken fajita rice skillet smothered in queso 🤤 The easiest weeknight dinner and one of those recipes the whole family will love. Save this one for your next easy dinner! One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Chicken Flautas Every week pls!✨😮‍💨  #easymeals #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #mealsonabudget #DinnerIdeas  Ingredients:  * 2–4 chicken breasts * 2 tbsp chicken bouillon * 1 onion * 6 garlic cloves, divided * 3 tomatoes * 1 jalapeño * 3 arbol chiles * ¼ cup water (or chicken broth) * Salt & pepper * Corn tortillas * Canola or vegetable oil * Sour cream * Shredded lettuce * Diced tomatoes * Diced onion * Pinto beans & Mexican rice, for serving Directions: Boil the chicken breasts with chicken bouillon, 1/2 of the onion, and 3 garlic cloves until fully cooked. Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

CHICKEN KEBAB #food #recipe #chicken #kebab GROUND CHICKEN 50 g red bell pepper, finely diced 50 g green bell pepper, finely diced 15 g fresh parsley, finely chopped 100 g yellow onion (1 onion), finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped 7 g salt (1⅙ tsp) 5 g ground cumin (1⅔ tsp) 5 g paprika (1⅔ tsp) 1 g chili flakes 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 2 g black pepper (⅔ tsp) lemon juice (½ lemon) 45 ml olive oil 750 g ground chicken WRAP wraps vegetables of your choice sauce of your choice Ready all the ingredients. Add the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, fresh parsley, yellow onion, and garlic to a food processor. Blend until you have a vegetable mixture. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large, deep bowl. Add the salt, ground cumin, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne pepper, black pepper, lemon juice, olive oil, and ground chicken. Knead until combined. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the chicken mixture evenly over the baking sheet and press it down firmly. Then cut the mixture into straight strips. Use a spoon to press half-moon shapes next to each other. Place the kebab in a preheated oven at 225°C (440°F). Bake for 20–25 minutes. Then switch the oven to the grill setting and grill for 5 minutes, or until the top is nicely golden brown and slightly crispy. Take a wrap and spread with your desired sauce. Fill the wrap with vegetables and pieces of kebab. Fold the wrap until closed. Grill the filled wrap until the wrap is nicely crispy and golden brown.

Twisted Apple Pie Rolls 🍎🤎 So many of you asked for an apple pie version, so here you go!! Let me know what you think 🤍 Full recipe here 👇🏼👇🏼👇🏼 Dough: 500g bread flour 180ml warm milk 120g (½ cup) 5% Greek yogurt 1 egg 25g sugar 1 tsp dry yeast 1 tsp salt 1 tsp vanilla 80g melted salted butter Apple Pie Filling: 600g Granny Smith apples, peeled & diced as small as possible 50g salted butter 65g brown sugar 50g maple syrup 1 tsp cinnamon ½ tsp apple pie spice (optional) Pinch of salt Juice of ½ lemon 10g cornstarch + 15ml water 2 tsp vanilla Sugar Glaze: 120g powdered sugar 1–2 tbsp milk ½ tsp vanilla (optional) Directions: Knead for 12–15 min until soft, smooth & slightly sticky (I use speed 2). Don’t skip the long kneading! Divide straight into 12 balls, cover & let rise for 1 hour. Meanwhile, melt the butter and add apples, sugar, maple, cinnamon, spice & salt. Cook 3–4 min. Add cornstarch mixed with water and cook another 1–2 min until thickened. Remove from heat, add lemon & vanilla and cool completely. Roll out each ball, add filling, fold, cut & twist as shown in the video. Let rest for 20 min. Brush with egg yolk + a splash of milk and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15–20 min until golden. Cool slightly, drizzle with glaze & enjoy warm 🍎✨#applepie #apple #baking #easyrecipe #foodie

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Sandwiches INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breast  1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, oregano, thyme 1 tsp each onion powder and garlic powder 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/3 cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped  1/2 cup of chicken broth  8 slices of bacon  1 block of cream cheese 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Brioche buns  INSTRUCTIONS  Spray a crockpot with cooking spray and add the chicken. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes. Next, add the minced garlic, chopped sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth.  Be sure to stir the sun dried tomatoes and garlic around. You want the sun dried tomatoes to be down in the chicken broth, so they don’t burn.  Cook on low for 4-6 hours. Once the chicken is fully cooked shred the chicken, add a block of cream cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Let this keep cooking on low until the cream cheese is melted and stir everything together well.  Cook bacon while cream cheese is melting. Once bacon is cooked build sandwiches on toasted buns and top with the crispy bacon. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpot

EASY MEALS FOR 2, EP. 24 🍯 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients Chicken * 375g-400g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * ¼ cup cornstarch Sauce * 60g honey (about 3 tbsp) * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 19g garlic, minced (4–5 large cloves) * 12g green onion whites, finely sliced Cornstarch Slurry * 1 tsp cornstarch * 2 tsp water Garnish * Sesame seeds * Sliced green onion greens Directions 1. Toss the chicken with the salt, garlic powder, pepper, and cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Heat enough neutral oil to lightly coat the bottom of a pan. Shallow fry the chicken over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 3. Reduce to medium heat. If needed, add a little more oil, then sauté the garlic and green onion whites for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 1–2 minutes. 5. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens. 6. Return the chicken to the pan and toss until every piece is well coated. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions greens Serve with steamed rice and enjoy! 🍚 #honeygarlicchicken #chickenrecipe #easyrecipe #cooking #creatorsearchinsights

ORANGE POSSET// aka the easiest dessert you'll ever make 🍊✨ you only need 10 minutes of prep time, and just three ingredients: cream, sugar, and citrus.  I made this last summer and haven’t stopped thinking about it since. It’s rich, silky, light and full of flavor. + it's also SO EASY to eat too. like you won't want to stop.  comment RECIPE and i'll send ya the deets, or snag it down below!  Serve it in little jars, in an orange peel, try different citrus like grapefruit, lemon, blood orange etc! the possibilities are endless.  SAVE this one for when you want to impress without turning on the oven because we all know it's going to be too hot for that this summer!  1 cup heavy cream 1/3 cup cane sugar 1/4 cup orange juice 1-2 tsp vanilla  Zest from 1 orange 3 Orange Peel halves, or 4oz ramekins In a bowl, mix together the sugar and orange zest. Use your hands to rub them together until the sugar is fragrant and tinted orange. Whisk in the heavy cream and vanilla until smooth. Pour the mixture into a saucepan over low heat and bring to a gentle simmer. Remove from heat and immediately stir in the orange juice. Strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl to remove the zest. Cut two oranges in half, scoop out the insides, and pour the cream mixture into each hollowed-out orange half (or use ramekins if preferred). Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until set. Garnish with a mint sprig before serving, if desired. #orangeposset #posset #easydessertrecipe #nobakedesserts

Creamy Chicken Tortilla Soup 🍲 I wish I could just stay in this fall soup series forever. Here’s how to make it: 1 T olive oil  1 T butter 2 large chicken breasts (about 1.5lbs) 1 onion, diced 1 jalapeño, diced (seeds removed for less heat) 8-10 cloves garlic, minced, to taste 3 tsp ground cumin 1 tsp chili powder  1 tsp smoked paprika  1 tsp oregano Salt and pepper to taste 4 cups chicken broth 1 (24 oz) can crushed tomatoes 1 (4 oz) can green chilies 1-2 tsp chicken bouillon, optional 1 T diced chipotle peppers 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed (or black beans) 1 can corn, drained 1 bay leaf 4 oz cream cheese, softened (can sub cream) Juice of 1 lime Fresh cilantro, chopped (to taste) Toppings: Tortilla chips, cheese, avocado, jalapeño, cilantro  1. Coat your chicken with olive oil and season with salt and pepper, cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, and oregano.   2. In a large pot, heat your butter over medium/high heat. Add in your chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side. They don’t need to be cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside.   3. In the same pot, add in a touch of olive oil, and sauté your diced onion and jalapeño with a pinch of salt along with your cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, oregano and black pepper. Sauté for about 5 minutes, or until tender.   4. Throw in the minced garlic and let it cook for about 30 seconds, just until fragrant.  5. Pour in the chicken broth, crushed tomatoes, green chilies, chipotle peppers, and chicken bouillon. Stir to combine and add the bay leaf. Season with salt and pepper.  6. Return the chicken to the pot and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.   7. Once done, remove the chicken, shred it, and add it back to the soup along with the beans and corn. Simmer for a few minutes to bring everything to temperature.  8. Add in the softened cream cheese, and stir until the cream cheese is melted and fully incorporated.  9. Finish it off with a squeeze of fresh lime juice and garnish with cilantro, if desired. Taste for seasonings, and serve with your favorite toppings! #chickentortillasoup #creamychickentortillasoup #tortillasoup #tortillasouprecipe #chickentortillasouprecipe #soup #souptok #souprecipe #fall #fallsoup #fallfood #fallrecipes #easyrecipe #easydinner #dinner #weeknightdinner #dinnerideas #foodtok #cooking #chickensoup

Macros (Per Serving - Makes 4) Calories — 492 Protein — 41g Carbs — 48g Fat — 17g Ingredients 🥣 12 oz or 340g cooked chicken breast, diced  6 oz or 180g dry orzo (cooked with chicken stock) 3 cups or 650g cherry tomatoes 2 Medium or 300g zucchini, chopped 5.3 oz or 150g Boursin Garlic & Fine Herbs cheese 2 oz or 56g grated Parmesan cheese Avacado/Olive Oil Spray Fresh basil Seasonings to Taste  chili flakes oregano black pepper salt How to make: 🧑‍🍳 1️⃣ Place the Boursin in the center of a baking dish, then add the cherry tomatoes and chopped zucchini around it. Season with chili flakes, oregano, salt and pepper, then lightly spray everything with oil. 2️⃣ Bake at 350°F (180°C) for about 35 minutes, until the tomatoes have softened and the Boursin is hot and creamy. 3️⃣ While that’s baking, cook the orzo according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain. 4️⃣ Remove the baking dish from the oven and mix everything together until the Boursin, tomatoes and zucchini create a creamy sauce. 5️⃣ Add the cooked orzo, chicken and fresh basil, then mix until everything is completely coated. 6️⃣ Top with grated Parmesan and place it back in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for another 5–10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted. 7️⃣ Let it cool for a few minutes, divide into 4 servings and enjoy!
